build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet-18 model using BasicBlock with 2-2-2-2 layer configuration for feature extraction
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet-50 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 layer configuration for deep feature extraction
build_resnet101_model: build a ResNet-101 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-23-3 layer configuration for deep feature extraction
create_basicblock_residual: create a BasicBlock residual layer with two 3x3 convolutions and optional learned downsampling
create_bottleneck_residual: create a Bottleneck residual layer with three convolutions (1x1-3x3-1x1) and expansion factor of 4
